subject.title: [Bug]: Windows gateway listens but local health/status time out after Telegram polling stall (v2026.5.20)

question: Should the open Telegram socket-timeout repair be accepted as the resolution for this issue, or should this issue remain the canonical tracker for a separate Gateway liveness/recovery policy after affected-host proof?
rationale: The available controlled reproduction did not establish that Telegram socket recovery resolves the alive-but-unresponsive Gateway condition, and an alternative process-exit policy would intentionally change operator recovery behavior.

options.title: Require symptom-level proof before resolving
options.body: Keep the issue open while the candidate PR supplies a redacted real run showing polling recovery and responsive local health/status after the induced failure.

options.title: Scope this issue to transport deadlock
options.body: Accept the PR as resolving the demonstrated Telegram half-open polling mechanism and open or retain a separate canonical tracker only if Gateway probe timeouts reproduce afterward.

options.title: Adopt supervisor escalation policy
options.body: Choose an explicit process-restart recovery policy after repeated channel-restart failures, with documented cross-platform supervisor behavior and upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Require symptom-level proof before resolving
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open while the candidate PR supplies a redacted real run showing polling recovery and responsive local health/status after the induced failure.

likelyOwner.reason: They performed the prior targeted live investigation and identified the exact remaining reproduction evidence needed to evaluate the proposed resolution.
